business_summary: Data Horizon Co.,Ltd. develops and provides data health related services to insurers and other organizations in Japan. The company offers various services comprising data health planning and analysis for planning, such as support for creating data health plans, potential analysis, dental care cost analysis, and health management analysis report creation. It also provides support for creating specific health checkup implementation plans; specific health checkup encouragement program; information to improve the rate of participation in specific health checkups; and analysis of the effectiveness of specific health checkups and specific health guidance. In addition, the company offers services to prevent severe illness; optimizing medical consultation behavior; encouraging consultation with a medical institution; promoting the use of generic drugs; and optimization of drug use. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan. Data Horizon Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of DeNA Co., Ltd.
